events.text:
Switching you back to Idli.

I wrote one chart, `status_share`, and saved it in `file-skills/field_visits_messy/charts/`. It's a sorted horizontal bar chart showing each status's share of all visits, with the percentage and visit count on each bar. Idli will draw it from your real data when you get back.

The request text was garbled by repeated "Status (…)" wording. I read it as "share of visits by status, overall".

The copy's status values are junk, so the preview showed made-up labels. On your real file the bars should be Done, Follow-up and Cancelled. The chart treats differences in capitalisation as the same status, shows blanks as "(blank)", and groups anything beyond the top eight into "Others".

I didn't change the skill, so it stays at version 1.
